name: Trent Ltd
about: Trent Ltd is engaged in retailing of apparels, footwear, accessories, toys, games, food, grocery & non food products through various of its retail formats/ concepts.

bull.text: Revenue has compounded 50.6% a year over 5 years
Profit grew faster than sales (63.5% vs 50.6% a year), so margins widened
EBITDA margin up 2.8 pts in two years to 18.7%

bear.text: Growth is slowing: revenue 34.5% a year over 3 years vs 50.6% over 5

claims.summary: No earnings call transcript on file to check against.

checks.title: Profit turns into cash
checks.text: Over the last 3 years operating cash flow was 120% of reported profit, so profit is turning into cash.

checks.title: Customers pay on time
checks.text: Customers now take 1 days to pay, against 2 three years ago.

checks.title: Profit comes from the core business
checks.text: Other income (interest, investment gains, one-offs) was 4% of pre-tax profit in the last 12 months. The core business earns most of the profit.

checks.title: Profit growth backed by operations
checks.text: In FY26, net profit grew 12% while operating profit grew 33%.

checks.title: Tax rate is normal
checks.text: Tax rate in Sep 2026 was 24%, against 23% on average over the four quarters before.

checks.title: No one-off boost this quarter
checks.text: No unusual jump in other income in Sep 2026.

checks.title: Debt under control
checks.text: Debt is 0.30× equity, against 0.41× two years earlier.

checks.title: Promoters are not selling
checks.text: Promoters hold 37.0%, unchanged over the last 4 reported quarters.
